name: GOL L.A.I.PFD ADR 1/2
summary: GOL L.A.I.PFD ADR 1/2 is an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) representing preferred shares of Gol Linhas Aereas Inteligentes S.A., a Brazilian airline. An ADR allows investors to trade shares of foreign companies on U.S. exchanges. Gol Linhas Aereas Inteligentes S.A. is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
